config.description: Method replication: the images are new Baidu street views (pitch 0°, 1024×512) in and around the four campuses in Qin, Wu, Yu & Jiang (2025, PLOS ONE): Lihu campus of Jiangnan University (Wuxi), Zijingang campus of Zhejiang University (Hangzhou), Xianlin campus of Nanjing University (Nanjing) and Minhang campus of East China Normal University (Shanghai), not the paper's 2017 images. Students rate each view on the paper's four questions, aesthetics, security, depression and vitality, from 1 to 5 (1 = strongly disagree, 5 = strongly agree). In the paper 100 volunteers, mostly students with at least one year of campus living, rated 3,119 images so that each image had at least 50 ratings. Differences from the original study: (1) 20 random views per participant; (2) the paper took views at compass headings 0°, 90°, 180° and 270°; here one of four directions relative to the road; (3) the campus sampling areas were drawn by us, so some views show streets just outside the campus gates.

paper.title: Enhancing student-centered walking environments on university campuses through street view imagery and machine learning
